component.name: DAoC Log Watcher
component.summary: Dark Age of Camelot realm points and kill tracker

description.p: DAoC Log Watcher is a real-time tracker for Dark Age of Camelot (Eden server). It reads your chat log as you play and gives you live statistics without any manual refreshing.

ul.li: Realm point breakdown by source: Player Kills, Campaign Quests, Battle Ticks, Siege, Assault Orders, Support Activity, Relic Captures, and Timed Missions
Rolling RP/h meter updated every 5 seconds, plus cumulative RP and RP/h charts
Character detection via the /stats command, tracking kills, deaths and K/D ratio automatically
Combat statistics: damage and healing by target, spell and attack type, with crit rates and multi-hit detection
Live warmap: keep ownership, sieges, fights and group activity, campaign events and relic ownership, all streamed from the Eden server
Kill heatmap showing where the fighting is happening across the frontier
Customizable dashboard with drag-to-arrange widgets and saved layout profiles
In-game overlay with realm points, damage, healing and a kill feed
Session browser and session history to review earlier play sessions
Log file maintenance: trim old sessions out of a large chat log into a compressed archive
Configurable time filters: current session, preset windows from 1 hour to 1 week, or a custom duration
Screenshot to clipboard with one click, and a dark and light theme

screenshot.caption: Live realm point and kill statistics dashboard
